title: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
description: Line and cover structures with insulating materials. May work with batt, roll, or blown insulation materials.

tasks.text: Fit, wrap, staple, or glue insulating materials to structures or surfaces, using hand tools or wires.
Cover and line structures with blown or rolled forms of materials to insulate against cold, heat, or moisture, using saws, knives, rasps, trowels, blowers, or other tools and implements.
Distribute insulating materials evenly into small spaces within floors, ceilings, or walls, using blowers and hose attachments, or cement mortars.
Move controls, buttons, or levers to start blowers and regulate flow of materials through nozzles.
Cover, seal, or finish insulated surfaces or access holes with plastic covers, canvas strips, sealants, tape, cement or asphalt mastic.
Fill blower hoppers with insulating materials.
Remove old insulation, such as asbestos, following safety procedures.
Prepare surfaces for insulation application by brushing or spreading on adhesives, cement, or asphalt, or by attaching metal pins to surfaces.

clusters.label: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Measure and cut insulation for covering surfaces, using tape measures, handsaws, power saws, knives, or scissors.
Read blueprints, and select appropriate insulation, based on space characteristics and the heat retaining or excluding characteristics of the material.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Operating system software
skills.def: Software to provide the operational interface to a computer and provide higher-level services and APIs. Examples: Microsoft Windows.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: CMSN FieldPAK, Comput-Ability Mechanical Insulation Key Estimator.

skills.name: Analytical or scientific software
skills.def: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research. Examples: North American Insulation Manufacturers Association NAIMA 3E Plus.
